comments.text: Moldova interests me because “cheap” only tells part of the story. I’m more curious about what everyday life actually feels like there—the food, villages, cities, family life, and pace of living. Would you visit Moldova for the low prices, or for the culture itself?

comments.author: @scioparto
comments.text: It was cheap very long time ago. Now it’s one of the most expensive countries in Europe especially if you live on the local income. The gas, the oil, imported fruits and vegetables are much more expensive than in EU. It’s a small not rich market, so everything has more higher price than in a big market. Moldova doesn’t have even H&M, Ikea , Zara, Amazon, nothing, just local resellers with a much higher prices and much smaller selection.
